name: In Good Company
source:
A kinetic short story about what friends do in the face of adversity.

Four associates are suddenly stopped in a snow lodge on their way to a celebration. Join the main character, Rocky, in learning about your associates as they struggle to come to terms with their snowed-in predicament!

[Edited from [url=https://mythridate.itch.io/in-good-company]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部没有分支选项的短篇故事，讲述朋友们如何面对逆境。

四名同事在前往庆祝活动的途中突遭阻碍，被困在一座雪中旅舍。与主角洛琪一起，在大家努力接受大雪封路的处境时，逐渐了解这些同行者吧！

[编译自[url=https://mythridate.itch.io/in-good-company]itch.io[/url]]
